Looks up a host name and returns how many addresses it has, IPv4 and IPv6. Use [GetHostAddress](GetHostAddress) to get them as text. A name that cannot be found returns 0. An empty name is this computer, which has one address for every network interface that is up: the ones other computers can reach first, then the ones that only work on the same network (`fe80::`), and the loopback addresses (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`) last.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print CountHostAddresses("127.0.0.1")
Print GetHostAddress$(1)
```

```text
1
127.0.0.1
```
@param host_name  A host name such as `localhost`, or an address as text. Brackets around an IPv6 address are allowed.
@returns The number of addresses.
@gap Not in the original, which only knows IPv4 ([CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs)). See [IPv6](IPv6).
